scope: Generated DWG DIMASSOC adapter retention and fail-closed target closure

source.refusal_control: locally-authored scratch DWG from libdxfrw_dimassoc_physical_transport_tests --generate-dimassoc; its dimension target is intentionally absent
source.success_control: locally-authored in-memory adapter model with one DIMENSION entity, one LINE osnap target, and one synthetic opaque-frame identity
source.physical_source: AC1018 Extruder2.dwg transports 23/23 selected DIMASSOC rows in the low-level probe, but its 474 entity parse failures prevent whole-file adapter output

implementation.retention: dx_iface retains typed DWG DIMASSOC callback data under record and byte bounds, keyed by import generation and source handle
implementation.output: same-version OBJECTS path considers only the current import generation and requires exact opaque source-frame identity, a unique typed dimension entity target, emitted entity targets for main/intersection osnap handles, and enabled output-record inventory before writing
implementation.qualification: opaque source frame is marked output-qualified only after the writer confirms one DIMASSOC OBJECTS record at the remapped handle
implementation.failure: incomplete or invalid target closure aborts OBJECTS emission; a later import resets the current-generation capture failure and ignores stale DIMASSOC rows

validation.result: passed 1/1; scratch DIMASSOC source refused at adapter closure gate; no DXF output published; scratch files removed
passed 1/1 generated DWG detail codec and ASCII/Binary DXF readback control
passed 1/1; a synthetic prior-generation DIMASSOC row neither blocks nor appears in a later DXF export

passed 2/2; each encoding refuses a missing osnap target without changing a destination sentinel, retries on the same adapter after correcting the target, and reads back one DIMASSOC whose dimension and osnap handles resolve to emitted entities
passed; 7/7 selected physical records transported by the low-level harness, 2 had resolved entity references and ASCII/Binary typed readback; this is not adapter whole-file output evidence

limitations: Successful output/readback and same-adapter correction/retry are proven only for the locally authored in-memory graph, not a physical producer DIMASSOC graph.
Independent source proof for target entity roles and broader producer/version profiles remain open.
The DIMASSOC physical body is not documented in ODA v5.4.1; native associative semantics and broader producer/version support remain unqualified.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository.
